subject.title: perf: avoid event-loop stall during embedded_run bootstrap-context

question: Should OpenClaw accept this PR's async bootstrap loader, custom yielding glob walker, and bootstrap hook interleaving as the fix for the linked bootstrap-context event-loop stall?
rationale: The patch is well-covered and keeps the public SDK surface stable, but it changes prompt-context loading and internal hook scheduling where automation should not own the final compatibility tradeoff.

options.title: Accept and land after gates
options.body: Treat the async loader, yielding walker, and bootstrap hook scheduling as the intended fix once exact-head required checks remain green.

options.title: Require connected runtime proof
options.body: Ask for a connected embedded_run or channel keepalive run before merge, trading speed for stronger end-to-end evidence.

options.title: Pause for stricter parity rules
options.body: Hold the PR until maintainers define deterministic glob ordering or hook scheduling invariants separately.

recommendation.title: Accept and land after gates
recommendation.body: Treat the async loader, yielding walker, and bootstrap hook scheduling as the intended fix once exact-head required checks remain green.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest feature-history signal across bootstrap reads, bootstrap hooks, and hook contract preservation touched by this decision.
